accepted_answers.name: requests.Session
accepted_answers.why: Standard answer: connection reuse via urllib3 pool manager, cookie/header persistence, zero new dependencies for requests users.

accepted_answers.name: httpx.Client
accepted_answers.why: Accepted modern alternative with the same pooling semantics plus async and HTTP/2 support.

notes: Strong consensus. A fresh requests.get per call re-does TCP+TLS handshakes; hand-rolled pooling reimplements what urllib3 already does.
problem: Reusing HTTP connections in Python with a new client per request or a hand-written pool.
